text.description_html:
LCN 9131 Benchmark Electromechanical Door Operator

The Benchmark low-energy operators are electrically powered and are cost-effective for retrofitting an activated or manual door. The 9130, 9140, and 9150 Series meet ANSI/BHMA A156.19 and ANSI A117.1 standards, are American Disabilities Act (ADA) compliant, UL-listed and feature a 2-year limited warranty.
The operators feature a Push ‘N Go activation, providing easy access for people with disabilities and the elderly. The Push ‘N Go feature takes over when a pedestrian manually opens the door to five degrees, then holds the door fully open for 1-30 seconds, depending on the time delay. Power Boost provides additional closing force in severe wind.

Specifications and Features: of LCN 9131 Benchmark Low-Energy Operator

  • Interior Door Width: 30" - 48"
  • Non-Handed
  • Grade 1 A156.19 and UL325/228
  • ADA Compliant
  • Meets BAA - Buy American Act
  • 100 Hour Salt Spray
  • Track Arm Standard
  • 27" Metal Cover Standard
  • Fasteners: Wood and Machine Screws
  • Mounting: Surface Mount
  • Hinges: Offset Pivot or Butt
  • Top Rail: Minimum 2"
  • Head Frame: Minimum 2"
  • Maximum Hold Time: Adjustable to approximately 30 seconds
  • Maximum Door Opening: 90 Degree manual and power
  • Aluminum Finish
  • Mounts on Pull Side of Single Interior Door
  • 2 Year Warranty
